basic_info.description: Located in a classic 1920s building in the heart of Russian Hill, Unit #8 is a warm and inviting  2BD/1BA TIC offers approximately 854 square feet of thoughtfully preserved charm and modern amenities.  Inside, the home features hardwood floors, period molding, and a stunning original fireplace, adding timeless character to the living space. The kitchen is functional and well-equipped, and the washer/dryer provides everyday convenience. There is a private backyard off of the living/dining room. The elevated space adjacent to the yard is also included as exclusive use. Great for your dog and so much potential.  Set within a secure, gated building with intercom entry and a peaceful garden walkway, residents also enjoy access to a shared rooftop deck with sweeping views of the city and Golden Gate Bridge ideal for relaxing or entertaining. With a stellar 97 Walk Score, you're just steps from Russian Hill's beloved cafes, shops, restaurants, cable cars, and MUNI bus routes. A Sirkin TIC agreement is in place, and HOA financials are professionally managed by Avenues HOA Financial Management.
